mapper.select: select ifnull((select sum(ifnull(in_qty, 0)) from erp_inventory_transaction where date(transaction_time) = curdate()), 0) as todayInboundQty, ifnull((select sum(ifnull(out_qty, 0)) from erp_inventory_transaction where date(transaction_time) = curdate()), 0) as todayOutboundQty, ifnull((select count(1) from erp_production_order where ifnull(order_status, '') not in ('已完成', '已关闭', '已取消', '已作废')), 0) as activeProductionCount, ifnull((select sum(ifnull(available_qty, 0) * ifnull(unit_price, 0)) from erp_inventory), 0) as inventoryValue, ifnull((select count(1) from erp_cut_order where cut_status in (0, 1) and plan_finish_time < now()), 0) as overdueCutCount, ifnull((select count(1) from erp_inbound_order where ifnull(order_status, '') in ('草稿', '已审核')), 0) as pendingInboundCount, ifnull((select count(1) from erp_outbound_order where ifnull(order_status, '') in ('草稿', '已审核', '已拣货')), 0) as pendingOutboundCount, ifnull((select sum(ifnull(total_amount, 0)) from erp_sales_order where ifnull(order_status, '') not in ('已完成', '已关闭', '已取消', '已作废')), 0) as openSalesAmount, ifnull((select sum(ifnull(available_qty, 0)) from erp_inventory where item_type = '成衣'), 0) as finishedGoodsQty

select date_format(d.day, '%m-%d') as name, ifnull(sum(t.in_qty), 0) as inboundQty, ifnull(sum(t.out_qty), 0) as outboundQty from ( select curdate() - interval 6 day as day union all select curdate() - interval 5 day union all select curdate() - interval 4 day union all select curdate() - interval 3 day union all select curdate() - interval 2 day union all select curdate() - interval 1 day union all select curdate() as day ) d left join erp_inventory_transaction t on date(t.transaction_time) = d.day group by d.day order by d.day
select ifnull(order_status, '未设置') as name, count(1) as value from erp_production_order group by ifnull(order_status, '未设置') order by value desc limit 8

select m.material_code as materialCode, m.material_name as materialName, m.unit_name as unitName, ifnull(inv.currentQty, 0) as currentQty, ifnull(m.safe_stock_qty, 0) as safeQty, case when ifnull(m.safe_stock_qty, 0) = 0 then 100 else round(ifnull(inv.currentQty, 0) / m.safe_stock_qty * 100, 0) end as percent from erp_material m left join ( select ms.material_id, sum(ifnull(i.available_qty, 0) + ifnull(i.locked_qty, 0)) as currentQty from erp_material_sku ms left join erp_inventory i on i.item_id = ms.material_sku_id and i.item_type = '物料' group by ms.material_id ) inv on inv.material_id = m.material_id where m.del_flag = '0' and ifnull(m.safe_stock_qty, 0) > 0 and ifnull(inv.currentQty, 0) < ifnull(m.safe_stock_qty, 0) order by percent asc, m.material_id desc limit 6

select s.sales_order_no as salesOrderNo, s.customer_name as customerName, s.delivery_date as deliveryDate, ifnull(s.total_qty, 0) as totalQty, ifnull(s.total_amount, 0) as totalAmount, ifnull(s.order_status, '') as orderStatus, ifnull(d.itemSummary, '') as itemSummary from erp_sales_order s left join ( select sales_order_id, group_concat(concat_ws(' / ', style_no, style_name, color_name, size_name, order_qty) order by sales_order_detail_id separator '; ') as itemSummary from erp_sales_order_detail group by sales_order_id ) d on d.sales_order_id = s.sales_order_id order by s.order_date desc, s.sales_order_id desc limit 6

select * from ( select '生产' as module, production_order_no as orderNo, customer_name as customerName, plan_finish_date as planDate, ifnull(total_qty, 0) as totalQty, ifnull(completed_qty, 0) as completedQty, ifnull(order_status, '') as status, case when ifnull(total_qty, 0) = 0 then 0 else round(ifnull(completed_qty, 0) / total_qty * 100, 0) end as progress from erp_production_order where plan_finish_date is not null and plan_finish_date >= curdate() - interval 1 day and ifnull(order_status, '') not in ('已完成', '已关闭', '已取消', '已作废') union all select '裁剪' as module, cut_order_no as orderNo, customer_name as customerName, date(plan_finish_time) as planDate, ifnull(total_qty, 0) as totalQty, 0 as completedQty, case cut_status when 0 then '待裁剪' when 1 then '裁剪中' when 2 then '已完成' when 3 then '已取消' else '未知' end as status, case when cut_status = 2 then 100 when cut_status = 1 then 50 else 0 end as progress from erp_cut_order where plan_finish_time is not null and date(plan_finish_time) >= curdate() - interval 1 day and cut_status in (0, 1) ) s order by planDate asc limit 8

select warehouse_name as warehouseName, sum(ifnull(available_qty, 0)) as availableQty, sum(ifnull(locked_qty, 0)) as lockedQty, sum(ifnull(available_qty, 0) * ifnull(unit_price, 0)) as stockAmount from erp_inventory group by warehouse_name order by stockAmount desc, availableQty desc limit 8
